task: Build a controlled Strix egress boundary and isolate the future runner
completed: Bound Strix run.json status, vulnerabilities ingestion, and persisted evidence to the same completed run directory.
Added regression coverage preventing cross-run artifact/provenance mixing.
Made active Strix scanner admission fail closed while its downstream runtime contract is not enforceable.
Exposed the Strix runtime-contract blocker through scanner capability diagnostics.
Added strix-execution-contract-v1 bound to job id, campaign policy fingerprint, normalized scope and exact request-rate ceiling.
Added canonical SHA-256 integrity and optional HMAC-SHA256 authentication using the existing audit signing key with domain separation.
Added a broker-bound request authorizer that rejects unsigned contracts, out-of-scope targets and request rates above the contract cap without performing network I/O.
Added redacted execution-contract trace metadata to Strix dry-run and result-ingestion events.
Added an admission-only Strix broker API that verifies a signed contract with a broker-scoped verification secret and performs no network I/O.
Placed the broker on an internal-only Docker network with no host port, data volume, Docker socket or Linux capabilities.
Added broker readiness, signed contract admission, wrong-key, out-of-scope, denied-host, rate-cap and unsafe-invariant tests.
Added CI coverage that builds the dedicated strix-broker Compose profile.
Added a separate read-only Strix egress service reachable from the broker but not directly from the scanner network.
Added GET/HEAD-only public-network egress with DNS resolution pinning, private/reserved IP rejection, TLS hostname preservation, no redirect following, bounded timeout/body and safe header handling.
Added actual per-contract request-start rate enforcement at the egress boundary.
Added double contract verification at broker and egress boundaries and preserved repeated response headers such as Set-Cookie.
Added three-zone Compose isolation tests and CI build coverage for both broker and egress services.
Added one-in-flight-request-per-contract enforcement on top of the signed RPS ceiling to bound slow-target concurrency.
Made broker readiness fail closed on the isolated egress service when the read-only proxy is enabled.
current_priority: Build a separately pinned/attested Strix runner with no direct target-network egress and force all supported target HTTP traffic through the broker.
blockers: The current scanner-worker is not the final isolated Strix runner and still participates in the general control network.
The bounded broker path currently supports only read-only GET/HEAD traffic, not the full method/tool surface Strix may require.
The exact Strix runtime version/image is not yet pinned and attested.
Contract v1 still uses symmetric HMAC verification rather than asymmetric verification.
safety_invariants: Fail closed on unknown scope or execution contract.
Independent validation remains required before confirmed findings.
next_steps: Validate and merge the egress concurrency/readiness hardening.
Create a dedicated Strix runner image/service attached only to internal runtime networks.
Pin the exact Strix source/version and attest it at runtime.
Route supported Strix HTTP traffic through the broker and prove direct target-network access is unavailable.
Expand the contract deliberately for any additional HTTP methods only after method-specific safety controls are defined.
Evaluate asymmetric contract signatures so verification services do not possess the signing secret.
